data.gender_notes: Roel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Roel is a Latin name derived from the Roman word 'rufulus', which means 'red-haired' or 'red-complexioned'. The name became associated with the Latin word 'lupus' or 'wolf' due to the similarity in pronunciation. In Christian tradition, Roel may also be connected to the biblical figure of Ruel, a descendant of Judah mentioned in the Old Testament.
data.etymology: Roel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Famous wolf.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
